summary: Master global custody, securities settlement, and asset servicing. Learn ISO 20022, T+1 cycles, and corporate actions. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Custody services training explains how securities are safeguarded and serviced through the post-trade lifecycle. Designed for post-trade and investment operations professionals, it supports the practical work of processing trades and maintaining accurate asset servicing. Learners explore settlement-failure analysis, corporate-action workflows, multi-currency liquidity management and sub-custodian oversight.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who operate within the post-trade ecosystem and require a deep technical understanding of securities movement and asset servicing.
modules: Global Custody Ecosystem and Market Infrastructure
Asset Servicing and Corporate Action Management
Cash Management and Liquidity in Custody
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience in financial services operations, investment banking, or fund administration. A basic understanding of the trade lifecycle and familiarization with SWIFT messaging concepts is recommended. No prior programming or coding knowledge is required for this course.
